_comment: Tileable material prompts, derived from docs/WORLD.md section 8.3 and constrained by the rules in 8.4.
_token_budget: CLIP TRUNCATES AT 77 TOKENS AND DISCARDS THE REST SILENTLY. The 2026-08-21 smoke test ran at 126 tokens, so a third of every prompt -- including the whole anti-shadow clause, which sat at the tail -- never reached the model. That is why both outputs came back with baked directional shadows. Full prompt is 'zone_style + material prompt', in that order, so the lighting instructions sit at the FRONT and survive truncation. Keep the total under 77. tile.py counts tokens and warns before generating anything.
_lighting_note: A game albedo map must be flat and unlit -- the engine lights it at runtime, so painted-in shadows double up and read wrong from every angle. 'no shadows, flat even light, albedo' is load-bearing. Do not trim it.
